# Isaac Seiler

Isaac Seiler leads marketing and communications at Summation and works across AI, public technology, and education. He is a Fulbright Scholar, Truman Scholar, Rhodes Scholarship finalist, WashU graduate, and OpenAI ChatGPT Lab member.

## Canonical Site

- [Home](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/): overview, featured work, photos, news, and Isaac AI.
- [Latest](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest): dated first-party writing on Summation AI, OpenAI, AI education, public technology, WashU, and the Truman Scholarship.
- [Projects](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects): project archive with individual pages for AI, public policy, journalism, communications, and research work.
- [Experience](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/experience): current work leading marketing and communications at Summation, plus OpenAI, Fulbright Taiwan, AI research, Congress, campaigns, and journalism.
- [Credentials](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/credentials): concise credentials and proof points.
- [Photos](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/photos): travel photography and image archive.

## High-Priority Project Pages

- [The ChatGPT Lab I Built in Taiwan](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/fulbright-focus-group-sponsored-by-openai): Isaac Seiler founded and led the Fulbright Taiwan ChatGPT Lab, an OpenAI-supported educator lab focused on practical, responsible ChatGPT use cases in education.
- [Artificial Intelligence in State Government Index](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/artificial-intelligence-in-state-government-index): A public benchmark by Isaac Seiler measuring generative AI adoption, training, governance, pilots, transparency, and preparedness across U.S. states and territories.
- [AI Platforms and Journalism Research](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/senior-thesis-local-journalism): Isaac Seiler's honors thesis analyzed AI, digital platforms, local journalism, democratic accountability, media policy, and newsroom labor through qualitative interviews.
- [Congressional Office Setup and 100 Day Report](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/congressional-office-setup-100-day-report): Isaac Seiler helped stand up a new congressional office and produced early systems, staffing, metrics, communications, and first-100-day reporting.
- [Electric Vehicle Charging Access Analysis](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/electric-vehicle-access-analysis): A GIS and quantitative analysis project by Isaac Seiler examining EV charging infrastructure access, charger density, income, race, and transportation equity.
- [Boehringer Cares Foundation Rebrand and Strategy Shift](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/boehringer-cares-foundation-rebrand-strategy-shift): A full rebrand and strategic redirect for Boehringer Cares, spanning narrative, UX, visual identity, and internal communications.
- [Communications Consultancy and Supporting Local Candidates](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/communications-consultancy-supporting-local-candidates): An independent consultancy effort supporting local candidates through campaign websites, digital strategy, and rapid-response communications.
- [The 2022 Institute for Nonprofit News Index Survey](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/2022-institute-for-nonprofit-news-index-survey): A large-scale nonprofit news research project involving data collection, survey synthesis, and direct stakeholder outreach.
- [Raised $20k for Local St. Louis Organizations](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/stl-immigrant-refugee-support-grant-process): A student-led philanthropy process by Isaac Seiler's WashU team evaluating and supporting St. Louis immigrant and refugee-serving nonprofits.
- [Exclusive Interview with High-Visibility Congressperson](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/exclusive-interview-with-high-visibility-congressperson): Early access-driven political reporting on then-Congressman Peter Meijer during a volatile post-impeachment period.
- [Helping Shape ChatGPT Before Launch](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/openai-product-testing-and-feedback): Inside my work with OpenAI's first ChatGPT Lab: testing products before release, pressure-testing student use cases, contributing to launch campaigns, and turning 100 real workflows into a published book.
- [Won Fulbright Award to Taiwan](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/projects/fulbright-award-to-taiwan): A sample blog post about leaving one life for another: notes, packing lists, and imaginary itineraries for a year that has not happened yet.

## Latest Articles

- [Joining Summation to Lead Marketing and Communications](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest/joining-summation-ai-marketing-communications) (2026-08-22): A new chapter in Seattle at Summation, bringing together AI, strategy, writing, and the work of making complex technology useful to real people.
- [What the OpenAI Student Collective Signals for Student-Led AI Learning](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest/openai-student-collective-student-led-ai-learning) (2026-08-22): OpenAI’s new Student Collective points toward a practical model for campus AI learning: peer-led workshops, studio time, projects, and visible outcomes.
- [From ChatGPT Lab to the Classroom: Practical AI Education Use Cases](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest/chatgpt-lab-ai-education-use-cases) (2026-08-22): The most useful AI education begins with real tasks, clear limits, and enough context for teachers and students to exercise judgment.
- [What a 56-Government Index Revealed About Public-Sector AI Adoption](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest/ai-adoption-state-government-index) (2026-08-22): A 900-input benchmark turned scattered public information into a clearer picture of AI guidance, training, pilots, governance, and transparency.
- [From WashU and the Truman Scholarship to Public-Interest AI Work](https://www.isaacseiler.xyz/latest/truman-scholar-washu-rhodes-finalist-public-service-ai) (2026-08-22): How public service, journalism, the Truman Scholarship, a Rhodes finalist selection, and WashU shaped a practical approach to AI.
